description: Two topic bugs parity #35 found and fixed: in an editing session (wbFillINOM and wbFillINOA on) three responses of BrokenSteel.esm's HELLO topic are shown (records.compare, the oracle's JumpTo), and the plugin is saved. The navigation tree sorts the responses of the topic (TwbGroupRecord.Sort), which gives the topic its INOM and INOA lists (an internal edit): the release writes the HELLO DIAL again with its QSTI list sorted, drops the five empty topic children groups of the file (the PrepareSave of the modified DIAL group), and writes the responses in the order of the file, since a group that is not modified writes its data as loaded (TwbDataContainer.WriteToStreamInternal). The port wrote the topic as loaded and kept the empty groups (records.compare did not sort), and once it sorted wrote the responses in the sorted order.
